_comment: System default scheduler tasks. Personal tasks go in ~/.memory/config/scheduler_config.json — entries there are merged on top of these by id.

default_tasks.description: Nightly chat→dream bridge — indexes role chat sessions into searchable knowledge
Daily runtime config validation — enable in ~/.memory/config/scheduler_config.json

config.goal: Run the MoJoAssistant configuration doctor to validate system health. Use bash_exec to run: /home/alex/Development/Personal/MoJoAssistant/venv/bin/python3 -c "from app.config.doctor import ConfigDoctor; import json; r = ConfigDoctor().run_all_checks(); errors = [c for c in r.checks if c.status == 'error']; warns = [c for c in r.checks if c.status == 'warn']; print(f'ERRORS: {len(errors)}, WARNS: {len(warns)}'); [print(f'  ERROR [{c.category}/{c.id}] {c.message}') for c in errors]; [print(f'  WARN  [{c.category}/{c.id}] {c.message}') for c in warns]" (use this exact interpreter path — bare python3 resolves to an unrelated conda environment on this host, not the project venv). Then save the output as your FINAL_ANSWER.

default_tasks.description: Weekly BRIDLE growth run — collects one-on-one signals, computes dimension drift, creates snapshot, sends HITL to owner

Weekly routing staleness check — compares live success rate to capability profile, flags drifted (model, level) cells. Enable in ~/.memory/config/scheduler_config.json

config.command: /home/alex/Development/Personal/MoJoAssistant/venv/bin/python3 -c "from app.scheduler.routing_staleness import run_weekly_check, format_weekly_summary; r = run_weekly_check(); print(format_weekly_summary(r))"
